text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Shah Alam) 2014.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 24 April 2014.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Shah Alam yang

bermula dari kilometer 17.9 laluan utama di koordinat U330299.391, T382997.376

Grid Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di

kilometer 45.9 laluan utama di koordinat U33961.109, T406025.571 Grid RSO

Geosentrik (GDM 2000) termasuklah Persimpangan Bertingkat Pandamaran,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Kebun, Plaza Tol Kemuning, Persimpangan Bertingkat

HICOM, Persimpangan Bertingkat Seafield, Pusingan U Bertingkat, Persimpangan

Bertingkat Kewajipan, Plaza Tol Sunway, Persimpangan Bertingkat Sunway dan

Persimpangan Bertingkat Kinrara, iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang 28 kilometer

diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

Pembatalan

3. Perintah Jalan Persekutuan (Lebuhraya Shah Alam) 1998 [P.U. (A) 133/1998]

dibatalkan.

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (SHAH ALAM EXPRESSWAY) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Selangor, makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Shah Alam Expressway)

Order 2014.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 24 April 2014.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the Shah Alam Expressway commencing

from kilometre 17.9 main line at coordinate N330299.391, E382997.376 Rectified Skew

Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 45.9 main

line at coordinate N33961.109, E406025.571 RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid

including Pandamaran Interchange, Kebun Interchange, Kemuning Toll Plaza,

HICOM Interchange, Seafield Interchange, Elevated U-Turn, Kewajipan Interchange,

Sunway Toll Plaza, Sunway Interchange and Kinrara Interchange, being a distance of

28 kilometre is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.

Revocation

3. The Federal Roads (Shah Alam Expressway) Order 1998 [P.U. (A) 133/1998]

is revoked.
